title: 4th of July Weekend in Boone NC: Things To Do
excerpt: Fourth of July weekend in Boone, NC is one of the best times of year to experience everything the High Country has to offer — from mountain trails and live music to small-town fireworks and cool summer evenings. Whether you're visiting for the holiday or quietly wondering what it might be like to own mountain property NC, this weekend will give you a real taste of life up here.
